title: Narra 4.1.36 — TV and playback polish
message: Install 4.1.36 over your current production-signed Narra app to keep your library, downloads, and settings. Android TV has refreshed Home, Search, details, and Settings screens with TV-code account connection and update checks. Subtitle discovery no longer restarts healthy anime playback.
changelog: Update over production-signed Narra 4.1.29 or later without uninstalling to keep local data.
Android TV Home, Search, detail, and Settings screens have been refreshed for remote navigation.
Connect a verified Narra account to TV using a short code from TV Settings.
Check for app updates directly from TV Settings.
Newly discovered subtitle tracks no longer restart a healthy anime stream.
